UPDATE A JOIN (
SELECT #{item.factoryCode} AS FACTORY_CODE, #{item.productCode} AS PRODUCT_CODE, #{item.mouldMethod} AS MOULD_METHOD, #{item.specCode} AS SPEC_CODE, #{item.constructionCode} AS CONSTRUCTION_CODE, #{item.productionVersion} AS PRODUCTION_VERSION, #{item.bomVersion} AS BOM_VERSION, #{item.updateBy} AS UPDATE_BY, #{item.updateTime} AS UPDATE_TIME
) TEMP ON A.FACTORY_CODE = TEMP.FACTORY_CODE AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = TEMP.PRODUCT_CODE AND A.MOULD_METHOD = TEMP.MOULD_METHOD
SET A.SPEC_CODE = TEMP.SPEC_CODE, A.CONSTRUCTION_CODE = TEMP.CONSTRUCTION_CODE, A.PRODUCTION_VERSION = TEMP.PRODUCTION_VERSION, A.BOM_VERSION = TEMP.BOM_VERSION, A.UPDATE_BY = TEMP.UPDATE_BY, A.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME WHERE A.IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE A JOIN (
SELECT #{item.factoryCode} AS FACTORY_CODE, #{item.embryoCode} AS EMBRYO_CODE, #{item.curingTime} AS CURING_TIME, #{item.curingTime2} AS CURING_TIME2, #{item.hydraulicPressureCuringTime} AS HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME, #{item.hydraulicPressureCuringTime2} AS HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2, #{item.moldCavity} AS MOLD_CAVITY, #{item.mouldClampingPressure} AS MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE, #{item.updateBy} AS UPDATE_BY, #{item.updateTime} AS UPDATE_TIME
) TEMP ON A.FACTORY_CODE = TEMP.FACTORY_CODE AND A.EMBRYO_CODE = TEMP.EMBRYO_CODE
SET A.CURING_TIME = TEMP.CURING_TIME, A.CURING_TIME2 = TEMP.CURING_TIME2, A.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME = TEMP.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME, A.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2 = TEMP.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2, A.MOLD_CAVITY = TEMP.MOLD_CAVITY, A.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE = TEMP.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE, A.UPDATE_BY = TEMP.UPDATE_BY, A.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME WHERE A.IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE A JOIN (
SELECT #{item.id} AS ID, #{item.factoryCode} AS FACTORY_CODE, #{item.productCode} AS PRODUCT_CODE, #{item.mouldMethod} AS MOULD_METHOD, #{item.constructionCode} AS CONSTRUCTION_CODE, #{item.productionVersion} AS PRODUCTION_VERSION, #{item.bomVersion} AS BOM_VERSION, #{item.embryoCode} AS EMBRYO_CODE, #{item.updateBy} AS UPDATE_BY, #{item.updateTime} AS UPDATE_TIME
) TEMP ON A.FACTORY_CODE = TEMP.FACTORY_CODE AND A.ID = TEMP.ID

mapper.update: UPDATE a JOIN ( SELECT EMBRYO_CODE, MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE, MOLD_CAVITY, CURING_TIME, CURING_TIME2, HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME, HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2 FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.EMBRYO_CODE ORDER BY a.ID DESC ) AS rn FROM a INNER JOIN ( SELECT EMBRYO_CODE, MAX(UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME FROM WHERE CURING_TIME IS NOT NULL AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCT_CODE NOT LIKE 'T%' GROUP BY EMBRYO_CODE ) b ON a.EMBRYO_CODE = b.EMBRYO_CODE AND a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 ) temp where rn = 1 ) b ON a.EMBRYO_CODE = b.EMBRYO_CODE SET a.CURING_TIME = b.CURING_TIME, a.CURING_TIME2 = b.CURING_TIME2, a.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME = b.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME, a.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2 = b.HYDRAULIC_PRESSURE_CURING_TIME2, a.MOLD_CAVITY = b.MOLD_CAVITY, a.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE = b.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE, a.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, a.UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 AND a.PRODUCT_CODE NOT LIKE 'T%'
